title: 36 Hours in Midcoast Maine
abstract: Along this rocky stretch of coast north of Portland, the sea may still be the star. But other attractions are gaining on it.

title: 36 Hours in Montpellier, France
abstract: In this Mediterranean city, trams are wrapped in style, city hall wears blue and the fruit of the sea decorates plates.

title: 36 Hours in Johannesburg
abstract: In a city that offers a window into South Africa’s past, Johannesburgers are working to create a vibrant future.

title: 36 Hours in Montpelier, Vt.
abstract: In this small town, under the gilded dome of the Vermont State House, you’ll find mountains, music, maple syrup and more.

title: 36 Hours in Sofia, Bulgaria
abstract: This capital city, marbled by a complex past, is looking to the future, targeting the title of European Capital of Culture 2019.
